name: Combined application and backup consolidation
on:
  push:
    branches: [chatgpt/1261-main-reconcile-20261030, main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:
permissions:
  contents: read
concurrency:
  group: combined-backups-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  # Supersede development runs for this PR/ref; retain every main acceptance run.
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.ref != 'refs/heads/main' }}
jobs:
  assemble:
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/chatgpt/1261-main-reconcile-20261030'
    steps:
      - run: |
          echo 'The exact combined baseline passed portable and63 full native suites per database. This is not deployment or approval of unintegrated feature groups. Full installed/upgrade/combined-release checks remain separate.' >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
    steps:
      - run: |
          echo 'The exact combined baseline passed portable and63 full native suites per database. This is not deployment or approval of unintegrated feature groups. Full installed/upgrade/combined-release checks remain separate.' >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
  checkout-admission:
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/chatgpt/checkout-current-main-20261103' || github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' || github.event_name == 'pull_request'
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 10
    outputs:
      required: ${{ steps.paths.outputs.required }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Admit exact source and checkout dependencies without narrowing historical triggers
        id: paths
        env:
          PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE: '1'
        run: |
          python3 - <<'CHECKOUT_PATHS'
          import ast, json, os, re, subprocess
          from pathlib import Path
          root = Path.cwd()
          def git(*args):
              return subprocess.check_output(['git', *args], cwd=root).decode().strip()
          head = git('rev-parse', 'HEAD')
          if head != os.environ['GITHUB_SHA'] or os.environ['GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT'] != '1':
              raise SystemExit('Use the actual first-attempt GitHub source; retain earlier attempts')
          event = json.loads(Path(os.environ['GITHUB_EVENT_PATH']).read_bytes())
          branch = 'refs/heads/chatgpt/checkout-current-main-20261103'
          explicit = os.environ['GITHUB_REF'] == branch or os.environ['GITHUB_EVENT_NAME'] == 'workflow_dispatch'
          paths = []
          if not explicit:
              before = event['pull_request']['base']['sha'] if os.environ['GITHUB_EVENT_NAME'] == 'pull_request' else event['before']
              if not re.fullmatch('[a-f0-9]{40}', before) or before == '0' * 40:
                  raise SystemExit('An actual comparison base is required for dependency admission')
              paths = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'diff', '--name-only', '-z', before, head], cwd=root).decode().split('\0')
              paths = [path for path in paths if path]
          tree = ast.parse((root/'tests/hosting_checkout_http_browser.py').read_bytes())
          declarations = [node for node in tree.body if isinstance(node, ast.Assign)
                          and any(isinstance(target, ast.Name) and target.id == 'SOURCE_PATHS' for target in node.targets)]
          if len(declarations) != 1:
              raise SystemExit('Exact checkout dependency declaration required')
          declared = ast.literal_eval(declarations[0].value)
          if not isinstance(declared, list) or len(declared) != len(set(declared)) or not all(isinstance(path, str) and path for path in declared):
              raise SystemExit('Exact unique checkout dependencies required')
          dependencies = set(declared) | {
              '.github/workflows/consolidation-after-backups.yml', 'AGENTS.md', 'VERSION',
              'tools/build.py', 'tools/directory-map.json', 'tools/acceptance-contract.json', 'tools/acceptance-reports.json',
              'tests/acceptance_environment.py', 'tests/installed_owner_authority_test.py',
              'tests/combined_source_composition.py', 'tests/combined_source_composition_test.py',
              'docs/COMBINED_SOURCE_COMPOSITION_20261102.json',
          }
          relevant = sorted(path for path in paths if path in dependencies or path.startswith(('site/', 'foundation/')))
          required = explicit or bool(relevant)
          out = root/'qa/checkout-admission'; out.mkdir(parents=True)
          record = {'head': head, 'tree': git('rev-parse', 'HEAD^{tree}'), 'run_id': os.environ['GITHUB_RUN_ID'],
                    'attempt': os.environ['GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT'], 'event': os.environ['GITHUB_EVENT_NAME'],
                    'ref': os.environ['GITHUB_REF'], 'explicit': explicit, 'changed_paths': paths,
                    'relevant_paths': relevant, 'required': required,
                    'scope': 'Dependency admission only; this record is not runtime acceptance.'}
          (out/'admission.json').write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2) + '\n')
          with Path(os.environ['GITHUB_OUTPUT']).open('a') as output:
              output.write('required=' + ('true' if required else 'false') + '\n')
          CHECKOUT_PATHS
      - name: Retain the actual dependency decision
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
        with:
          name: checkout-admission-${{ github.sha }}-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: qa/checkout-admission/
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 14
  checkout-current:
    needs: checkout-admission
    if: needs.checkout-admission.outputs.required == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 65
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        php: ['8.2', '8.4']
        database: [mariadb-10.11, mysql-8.4]
    services:
      checkout_database:
        image: ${{ matrix.database == 'mysql-8.4' && 'mysql:8.4' || 'mariadb:10.11' }}
        env:
          MARIADB_ROOT_PASSWORD: isolated-ci-root-only
          MARIADB_DATABASE: cwp_test
          MARIADB_USER: cwp_test
          MARIADB_PASSWORD: local-ci-only
          MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD: isolated-ci-root-only
          MYSQL_DATABASE: cwp_test
          MYSQL_USER: cwp_test
          MYSQL_PASSWORD: local-ci-only
        ports: ['3306']
        options: >-
          --health-cmd="mysqladmin ping --silent"
          --health-interval=5s --health-timeout=5s --health-retries=20
    env:
      CWP_PHP_VERSION: ${{ matrix.php }}
      CWP_DATABASE: ${{ matrix.database }}
      CWP_TEST_DATABASE: cwp_test
      CWP_TEST_HOST: 127.0.0.1
      CWP_TEST_USER: cwp_test
      CWP_TEST_PASSWORD: local-ci-only
      PHP_BINARY: /usr/bin/php${{ matrix.php }}
      PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE: '1'
      TZ: UTC
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Record exact current source before runtime setup
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "$(id -u)" -ne 0
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$GITHUB_SHA"
          test "$GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT" = 1
          git merge-base --is-ancestor d9e34d2f8483fcd7630d799725fac773561f5183 HEAD
          git diff --exit-code
          git diff --cached --exit-code
          mkdir -p qa/checkout-current-source
          python3 - <<'CHECKOUT_SOURCE'
          import hashlib, json, os, subprocess
          from pathlib import Path
          root = Path.cwd()
          git = lambda *args: subprocess.check_output(['git', *args], cwd=root).decode().strip()
          paths = ['.github/workflows/consolidation-after-backups.yml', 'tests/hosting_checkout_native.php',
                   'tests/hosting_checkout_http_fixture.php', 'tests/hosting_checkout_http_browser.py',
                   'tests/hosting_checkout_http_guards.py', 'tests/hosting_billing_options_wiring.py',
                   'tests/installed_owner_authority.py', 'tests/installed_owner_authority.php', 'tests/acceptance_environment.py',
                   'tools/build.py', 'tools/directory-map.json']
          record = {'commit': git('rev-parse', 'HEAD'), 'tree': git('rev-parse', 'HEAD^{tree}'),
                    'parents': git('show', '-s', '--format=%P', 'HEAD').split(), 'github_sha': os.environ['GITHUB_SHA'],
                    'event': os.environ['GITHUB_EVENT_NAME'], 'ref': os.environ['GITHUB_REF'],
                    'run_id': os.environ['GITHUB_RUN_ID'], 'attempt': os.environ['GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT'],
                    'selected_php': os.environ['CWP_PHP_VERSION'], 'selected_database': os.environ['CWP_DATABASE'],
                    'files': {p: hashlib.sha256((root/p).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in paths},
                    'scope': 'Current checkout matrix only; not full Application, release publication or deployment.'}
          (root/'qa/checkout-current-source/source.json').write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2) + '\n')
          CHECKOUT_SOURCE
      - name: Prepare the maintained selected PHP database and browser environment
        env:
          CWP_ASSIGNED_PORT: ${{ job.services.checkout_database.ports[3306] }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          printf 'CWP_TEST_PORT=%s\n' "$CWP_ASSIGNED_PORT" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          export CWP_TEST_PORT="$CWP_ASSIGNED_PORT"
          # Use one package source for the versioned CLI, extensions and Apache module.
          # Ubuntu 24.04 retains its distro PHP 8.3 path; other selected versions
          # require the PHP maintainer's signed Ubuntu Noble package repository.
          if [ "$CWP_PHP_VERSION" != "8.3" ]; then
            sudo apt-get -o Acquire::Retries=5 -o APT::Update::Error-Mode=any update -qq
            sudo apt-get -o Acquire::Retries=5 install -y software-properties-common
            sudo add-apt-repository --yes --no-update ppa:ondrej/php
            # setup-php f3e473d116dcccaddc5834248c87452386958240 documents this
            # fixed mirror. Preserve Launchpad's original scoped publisher key.
            sudo python3 - <<'CWP_PHP_MIRROR'
          from pathlib import Path
          import re, subprocess, tempfile
          source = Path('/etc/apt/sources.list.d/ondrej-ubuntu-php-noble.sources')
          primary = 'https://ppa.launchpadcontent.net/ondrej/php/ubuntu/'
          mirror = 'https://ppa.setup-php.com/ondrej/php/ubuntu/'
          fingerprint = 'B8DC7E53946656EFBCE4C1DD71DAEAAB4AD4CAB6'
          if source.is_symlink() or not source.is_file() or source.stat().st_size > 65536:
              raise SystemExit('Expected regular Noble PHP PPA source is unavailable')
          original = source.read_bytes()
          text = original.decode('utf-8')
          for field, expected in [('Types', 'deb'), ('URIs', primary), ('Suites', 'noble'), ('Components', 'main')]:
              if re.findall(r'^' + field + r': (.*)$', text, re.M) != [expected]:
                  raise SystemExit('Unexpected Noble PHP PPA source field: ' + field)
          if re.search(r'^(?:Trusted|Allow-Insecure|Allow-Weak|Allow-Downgrade-To-Insecure):', text, re.M | re.I):
              raise SystemExit('Unsafe repository trust override refused')
          keys = re.findall(r'^Signed-By:([^\n]*(?:\n[ \t][^\n]*)*)', text, re.M)
          if len(keys) != 1:
              raise SystemExit('Exactly one publisher Signed-By field is required')
          signed_by = '\n'.join('' if line.strip() == '.' else line.strip() for line in keys[0].splitlines()).strip()
          if signed_by.startswith('-----BEGIN PGP PUBLIC KEY BLOCK-----'):
              key = signed_by.encode('ascii')
          else:
              key_path = Path(signed_by)
              if key_path.parent not in (Path('/usr/share/keyrings'), Path('/etc/apt/keyrings')) or key_path.is_symlink() or not key_path.is_file() or key_path.stat().st_size > 65536:
                  raise SystemExit('Unexpected publisher key file')
              key = key_path.read_bytes()
          with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='cwp-public-key-inspection-') as key_home:
              shown = subprocess.run(['gpg', '--batch', '--no-options', '--homedir', key_home, '--no-autostart', '--with-colons', '--show-keys'], input=key, capture_output=True, check=True).stdout.decode('utf-8')
          if len(re.findall(r'^pub:', shown, re.M)) != 1 or re.findall(r'^fpr:::::::::([A-F0-9]{40}):', shown, re.M)[:1] != [fingerprint]:
              raise SystemExit('Unexpected PHP PPA signing identity')
          changed = re.sub(r'^URIs: ' + re.escape(primary) + r'$', 'URIs: ' + mirror, text, count=1, flags=re.M).encode('utf-8')
          if changed.replace(mirror.encode(), primary.encode(), 1) != original or changed == original:
              raise SystemExit('Only the exact repository URI may change')
          source.write_bytes(changed)
          print('Noble PHP PPA mirror selected; original publisher Signed-By retained: ' + fingerprint)
          CWP_PHP_MIRROR
          fi
          sudo apt-get -o Acquire::Retries=5 -o APT::Update::Error-Mode=any update -qq
          sudo apt-get -o Acquire::Retries=5 install -y "php${CWP_PHP_VERSION}-cli" "php${CWP_PHP_VERSION}-mysql" "php${CWP_PHP_VERSION}-gd" "php${CWP_PHP_VERSION}-zip" "php${CWP_PHP_VERSION}-curl" "php${CWP_PHP_VERSION}-xml" "php${CWP_PHP_VERSION}-mbstring"
          export PHP_BINARY="/usr/bin/php${CWP_PHP_VERSION}"
          test -x "$PHP_BINARY"
          printf 'PHP_BINARY=%s\n' "$PHP_BINARY" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          "$PHP_BINARY" -v
          "$PHP_BINARY" -m
          if [ "$CWP_DATABASE" = "mysql-8.4" ]; then
            docker exec -e MYSQL_PWD=isolated-ci-root-only ${{ job.services.checkout_database.id }} mysql -uroot -e 'SET GLOBAL log_bin_trust_function_creators=1'
          fi
          python3 -m venv .ci-venv
          .ci-venv/bin/pip install --disable-pip-version-check requests beautifulsoup4 cryptography==50.0.1 playwright
          .ci-venv/bin/python -m playwright install --with-deps chromium
          python3 tests/acceptance_environment.py --lane native
      - name: Refresh canonical source and build archives from the exact clean CI commit
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test -x "$PHP_BINARY"
          for ignored in .ci-venv/bin/python qa/checkout-current-source/source.json qa/native-environment-results.json dist/checkout-package-probe; do
            git check-ignore --quiet -- "$ignored"
          done
          python3 tools/build.py --refresh > qa/checkout-current-source/refresh.stdout.log 2> qa/checkout-current-source/refresh.stderr.log
          test ! -s qa/checkout-current-source/refresh.stderr.log
          git diff --exit-code
          git diff --cached --exit-code
          python3 tools/build.py --commit "$GITHUB_SHA" > qa/checkout-current-source/build.stdout.log 2> qa/checkout-current-source/build.stderr.log
          test ! -s qa/checkout-current-source/build.stderr.log
      - name: Retain exact native output package and historical callback contracts
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          .ci-venv/bin/python tests/hosting_checkout_http_guards.py > qa/checkout-current-source/output-guards.json 2> qa/checkout-current-source/output-guards.stderr.log
          test ! -s qa/checkout-current-source/output-guards.stderr.log
          .ci-venv/bin/python tests/hosting_billing_options_wiring.py --report qa/checkout-current-source/billing-wiring.json > qa/checkout-current-source/billing-wiring.stdout.log 2> qa/checkout-current-source/billing-wiring.stderr.log
          test ! -s qa/checkout-current-source/billing-wiring.stderr.log
      - name: Run all 79 native checkout assertions with closed synthetic transports
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          CWP_TEST_HOSTING_CHECKOUT=1 "$PHP_BINARY" -d display_errors=0 -d zend.exception_ignore_args=1 -d allow_url_fopen=0 -d disable_functions=curl_exec,curl_multi_exec,fsockopen,pfsockopen,stream_socket_client,mail,exec,shell_exec,system,passthru,popen,proc_open tests/hosting_checkout_native.php > qa/checkout-current-source/native.stdout.log 2> qa/checkout-current-source/native.stderr.log
          test ! -s qa/checkout-current-source/native.stderr.log
      - name: Continue the same native state through the actual packaged current-clock browser
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          .ci-venv/bin/python tests/hosting_checkout_http_browser.py --full-suite > qa/checkout-current-source/browser.stdout.log 2> qa/checkout-current-source/browser.stderr.log
          test ! -s qa/checkout-current-source/browser.stderr.log
      - name: Require exact current source runtime named outcomes and every original capture
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          .ci-venv/bin/python - <<'CHECKOUT_COMPLETE'
          import hashlib, json, os, subprocess, sys
          from pathlib import Path
          root = Path.cwd(); qa = root/'qa'
          sys.path.insert(0, str(root/'tests'))
          import hosting_checkout_http_browser as driver
          def require(value, message):
              if not value:
                  raise SystemExit(message)
          def sha(raw):
              return hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
          native_raw = (qa/'hosting-checkout-native-results.json').read_bytes()
          native = driver.validate_native(native_raw, (root/'tests/hosting_checkout_native.php').read_text(), os.environ['CWP_PHP_VERSION'])
          browser = json.loads((qa/'hosting-checkout-http-results.json').read_bytes())
          environment = json.loads((qa/'native-environment-results.json').read_bytes())
          require(environment['passed'] is True and all(row['passed'] is True for row in environment['checks']), 'Actual selected environment failed')
          require(environment['selected'] == {'php': os.environ['CWP_PHP_VERSION'], 'database': os.environ['CWP_DATABASE']}, 'Selected runtime changed')
          require(native['runtime'] == {'php': environment['cli']['version'], 'database': environment['database_version']}, 'Actual native runtime changed')
          require(browser['passed'] is True and browser['failure'] is None and browser['checks'] and all(row['passed'] is True for row in browser['checks']), 'Original browser outcomes failed')
          source = browser['source']
          require(source['commit'] == os.environ['GITHUB_SHA'] == subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD']).decode().strip(), 'Actual source changed')
          require(source['tree'] == subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD^{tree}']).decode().strip() and source['run'] == os.environ['GITHUB_RUN_ID'] and source['attempt'] == os.environ['GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT'] == '1', 'Source/run/attempt binding changed')
          require(source['native_report_sha256'] == sha(native_raw) and browser['runtime']['native'] == native['runtime'], 'Native-to-browser proof changed')
          require(set(source['files']) == set(driver.SOURCE_PATHS) and all(source['files'][p] == sha((root/p).read_bytes()) for p in driver.SOURCE_PATHS), 'Actual driver dependencies changed')
          require(browser['full_acceptance'] is False and browser['visual_approval'] is False, 'Do not claim full acceptance or visual approval')
          require(len(driver.ALL_CAPTURES) == len(set(driver.ALL_CAPTURES)) == 32, 'All original capture names are required')
          for name in driver.ALL_CAPTURES:
              require(name in browser['files'] and (qa/name).is_file() and not (qa/name).is_symlink() and (qa/name).stat().st_size > 0, 'Missing actual capture: ' + name)
          for name, fact in browser['files'].items():
              path = qa/name
              require(Path(name).name == name and path.is_file() and not path.is_symlink(), 'Unsafe owned browser evidence')
              require(fact == {'bytes': path.stat().st_size, 'sha256': sha(path.read_bytes())}, 'Owned browser evidence changed: ' + name)
          archive = root/'dist'/browser['package']['name']
          manifest = archive.with_suffix('.manifest.json')
          require(archive.is_file() and not archive.is_symlink() and sha(archive.read_bytes()) == browser['package']['sha256'] and archive.stat().st_size == browser['package']['bytes'], 'Actual tested COMPLETE package changed')
          require(sha(manifest.read_bytes()) == browser['package']['manifest_sha256'] and json.loads(manifest.read_bytes())['source_commit'] == source['commit'], 'Tested package source manifest changed')
          result = {'passed': True, 'source': source, 'runtime': native['runtime'], 'native_checks': len(native['checks']),
                    'browser_check_entries': len(browser['checks']), 'captures': list(driver.ALL_CAPTURES),
                    'native_report_sha256': sha(native_raw), 'browser_report_sha256': sha((qa/'hosting-checkout-http-results.json').read_bytes()),
                    'scope': 'Exact dedicated checkout matrix lane only. Nested callback lists repeat parent outcomes and are not added to execution counts. Visual review and full Application acceptance remain separate.'}
          (qa/'checkout-current-source/completion.json').write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + '\n')
          CHECKOUT_COMPLETE
          git diff --exit-code
          git diff --cached --exit-code
      - name: Preserve original outcomes captures diagnostics and the exact tested package on failure or success
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
        with:
          name: checkout-current-${{ matrix.php }}-${{ matrix.database }}-${{ github.sha }}-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: |
            qa/
            dist/*-COMPLETE-UPLOAD.zip
            dist/*-COMPLETE-UPLOAD.manifest.json
            dist/*-COMPLETE-UPLOAD.directories.txt
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 14

## P-05 — Web-design project workspace and progress

Each project has a client-visible dashboard: agreed scope, proposal/version, assigned contact, current stage, target dates, milestone list, action required from the client, open questions/blockers, and a dated activity timeline. Suggested configurable stages are Discovery, Content, Design, Development, Review, Ready for launch, Launched and Maintenance. Stage changes and dates come from actual staff updates; never invent progress percentages, completion or guaranteed delivery dates.

Provide protected preview/staging links, design versions, feedback threads, revision requests, client content uploads, version-specific approvals, deliverables and payment milestones. Distinguish staff-only notes from published client updates. A design approval references the exact reviewed version; changing it creates a new revision rather than rewriting history. Financial progress and production progress remain separate.

**Partial delivery — additional company contacts:** scoped contact identities with separate project-review, billing and download permissions are implemented on `devin/non20i-client-contacts`. declare(strict_types=1);
if (!defined('CWP_BOOT')) { http_response_code(404); exit; }
/** Re-reads account and contact authority inside the upload transaction, after the shared account lock, before any private file or row write. */
function studio_upload_authority(int $jobId,string $actor,?array $client,?array $contact): void {
 if($actor==='admin'){if(!one('SELECT id FROM '.table('studio_jobs').' WHERE id=? FOR UPDATE',[$jobId]))throw new InvalidArgumentException('Project not found.');return;}
 if(!$client)throw new InvalidArgumentException('Sign in to upload.');
 if(!one('SELECT id FROM '.table('studio_jobs').' WHERE id=? AND client_id=? FOR UPDATE',[$jobId,(int)$client['id']]))throw new InvalidArgumentException('Project not found.');
 $fresh=one('SELECT id,auth_version FROM '.table('studio_clients').' WHERE id=? AND active=1 FOR UPDATE',[(int)$client['id']]);

# Client cloud website requests

## Implementation checkpoint — 2026-10-18

Branch `codex/twentyi-client-cloud-websites` starts at main `e397d9a6e293850e8dff61a593e3ba39ee178400`. It adds the client-to-owner journey for creating a website on an existing, explicitly assigned cloud server. This is an unreleased implementation. Published 1.25.0 remains immutable; no live provider operation or deployment occurred.

The owner requested a complete client portal. Clients can submit exact primary/additional domains for review, cancel a pending request, and read its outcome. Owners can decline with a message or review current domain authority and server capacity before creating the requested website through the existing one-send cloud operation. An accepted returned package requires a separate hosting refresh, exact-package review and explicit client assignment. The request links directly to its retained grant's existing confirmation form, independent of the current profile or the recent-40 history list.

This uses the existing `CloudWebsiteCreate` contract. It does not purchase a cloud server, register a domain, invent a price, trigger payment, send mail, prove website health, or provide SSH. Existing direct owner creation remains supported.

## Use and current limitation

An owner prepares **Client website requests** in 20i settings after existing inventory, operation, client and administrator storage is ready. GET requests never create tables. Clients open **Cloud website requests** from Hosting services. An active primary client session and the exact current server assignment are required; support and contact-context sessions cannot submit decisions.

Intake currently requires an authenticated complete cloud inventory observation from the last 15 minutes. A newer failed or unfinished read also prevents submission. The page asks the client to contact the studio for a refresh when no eligible server is available. Owner dispatch separately requires a fresh observation and current owner password. Static protected intake without this freshness dependency remains a future usability improvement, not implemented behavior.

Domains are not trimmed, lowercased or truncated. The existing maximum of 20 distinct aliases applies. Intake sizes the complete future approval document against its existing 4,096-byte limit, so a valid but oversized domain list is rejected before saving an unfulfillable request. A client may make at most ten requests per 24 hours; the HTTP controller also limits repeated submissions. Overlapping pending or unresolved client requests are refused, and the existing shared operation still checks every prior cloud creation before dispatch.

## Retained history and authority

- `provider_cloud_site_request_events` stores canonical signed request, cancellation, decline and dispatch events. Its schema marker, ordinal/head pointer, exact audit witnesses and event sequence must agree. Unknown namespace additions, partial preparation, missing rows and paired row/audit loss do not become empty history.
- Client and owner events retain their account identity and authorization-version hash. Owner dispatch checks the original client's active database record; it never impersonates a client session. Account changes prevent new sends and may hide private client history. Owners may decline a still-pending request after an assignment changes.
- The client dispatch event and the existing operation grant/start audit commit in one existing staff-mutex transaction. The grant contains only fixed-size request/dispatch IDs and event HMAC fingerprints. No separate reservation or duplicated outcome table is introduced.
- Shared document/history validation resolves the signed request origin even outside the new controller. Own event validation and direct expected-grant comparison avoid recursive shared decoding. Missing origin cannot silently convert a client request into an ordinary owner grant.
- The existing gateway and durable operation ledger remain the sole source of dispatch outcomes. Exact replay reads that outcome with zero DNS or provider send, including after a newer inventory observation. Current owner/password, original-client and assignment authority are still checked. A different dispatch/grant identity cannot reopen a transitioned request.
- Before DNS, credential opening and transport authorization, the original client and current assignment are rechecked. Known pre-send refusal, accepted-pending and uncertain outcomes retain their distinct meanings. Interrupted or missing outcomes remain fenced; no fabricated completion or automatic retry is added.
- Cancellation and decline cannot alter a dispatched request. Exact cancellation/decline replays do not append events. Missing history requires recovery of the original records, not reconstruction from a new approval.

## Integration and file ownership

Root owns `site/app/providers/cloud_site_requests.php`, shared cloud creation, exact-confirmation rendering, routes, navigation, acceptance wiring, packaging and documentation. Domains owns the new document/storage/schema and pure document tests. Catalog owns the new view/controllers, modeled screen tests and packaged browser continuation. VPS owns the isolated native database/gateway/concurrency fixture and installed-update companion. Shared integration is sequential; other lanes and Devin's non-20i work are preserved.

The new portal route is `?cloud_websites=1`. Owner actions use `provider_inventory_cloud_request_*` and retain the existing owner-only permission policy. Exact package confirmation uses `provider-settings&cloud_website_confirm=<grant-id>` with a validated local fragment. Client DTOs contain no owner identity, private proof, credentials or operation grant ID. Confirmation uses the existing separate package-observation and assignment history.

## Evidence and remaining gates

Actual local results at the implementation checkpoint:

- 141 pure document/projection checks pass in both normal and minimal PHP 8.4.25.
- 98 actual view/controller-body checks pass in both PHP modes with modeled authority/service dependencies. These do not establish SQL or browser behavior.
- Both real module entry paths cold-load in both modes with SQL sentinels; all 34 original extracted legacy-context checks pass per mode.
- Changed-source syntax and existing cloud operation/binding/view regression scripts pass locally. The bounded independent service review found no concrete source blocker in origin validation, atomic admission, current authority or replay.
- The canonical installer refresh completed with all shipping PHP/JavaScript syntax and dependency/mirror checks. Documentation validation passed12 required documents,272 Markdown files and1,858 local links, including32 heading links. These are local source/package-preparation results.

The native fixture is opt-in (`CWP_TEST_CLOUD_SITE_REQUESTS=1`), restricted to a disposable Linux `cwp_test` database and the new `cwri_` namespace/private directory. # The additions below use only the installed synthetic fixture. They do not
# prepare extra requests or change a request's captured invoice fingerprint.
PAYMENT_LINK_CAPTURES = tuple(
    'Payment-Link-' + state + '-' + viewport + '.png'
    for state in ('Valid', 'Terminal') for viewport in ('Desktop', 'Mobile')
)


def payment_link_local_url(link):
    value = urlparse(link)
    base = urlparse(BASE)
    query = parse_qs(value.query, keep_blank_values=True)
    if (value.scheme, value.netloc) != (base.scheme, base.netloc) or value.fragment or value.path != base.path.rstrip('/') + '/existing/index.php':
        raise AssertionError('Payment link escaped the installed local fixture')
    if set(query) != {'page', 't'} or query['page'] != ['pay'] or len(query['t']) != 1 or len(query['t'][0]) != 64 or any(c not in '0123456789abcdef' for c in query['t'][0]):
        raise AssertionError('Payment link has an unexpected route or token shape')
    return link


def payment_link_rows():
    # These exact financial and binding tables must remain unchanged by a GET.
    # Optional ledger/trial tables are absent before their original later setup.
    tables = ('studio_invoices', 'studio_jobs', 'studio_clients', 'payment_requests',
              'payment_gateways', 'audit', 'invoice_payments', 'payment_attempts',
              'payment_notifications', 'catalog_invoice_snapshots')
    present = {r['TABLE_NAME'] for r in db('SELECT TABLE_NAME FROM information_schema.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA=DATABASE()')}
    return {name: db('SELECT * FROM ci_' + name + ' ORDER BY id') if 'ci_' + name in present else None for name in tables}


def payment_link_terminal_page(response, state, forbidden, label):
    page = soup(response)
    cards = page.select('article.workspace-card')
    status = cards[0].select_one('.workspace-status') if len(cards) == 1 else None
    check(label + ' has the exact safe terminal state', response.status_code == 200 and status is not None and status.get_text(strip=True) == state)
    body = page.get_text(' ', strip=True)
    check(label + ' exposes no invoice metadata or stale amount', len(cards) == 1 and not cards[0].select('h2, .prose, strong') and '$' not in cards[0].get_text() and all(not value or value not in body for value in forbidden) and ' USD due' not in body and ' EUR due' not in body and 'request expires' not in body)


def payment_link_read_only_terminal(link, state, forbidden, label):
    before = payment_link_rows()
    response = requests.get(payment_link_local_url(link), allow_redirects=False)
    payment_link_terminal_page(response, state, forbidden, label)
    check(label + ' GET preserves financial and binding rows', payment_link_rows() == before)


def payment_link_http_isolation(link, request):
    original = db('SELECT * FROM ci_studio_invoices WHERE id=?', [INVOICE['id']])[0]
    job = db('SELECT * FROM ci_studio_jobs WHERE id=?', [original['job_id']])[0]
    client = db('SELECT * FROM ci_studio_clients WHERE id=?', [job['client_id']])[0]
    other = db('SELECT * FROM ci_studio_jobs WHERE id<>? AND client_id<>? ORDER BY id LIMIT 1', [job['id'], client['id']])[0]
    before = payment_link_rows()
    response = requests.get(payment_link_local_url(link), allow_redirects=False)
    page = soup(response)
    card = page.select_one('article.workspace-card')
    expected_amount = '$' + format(request['amount_cents'] / 100, '.2f') + ' USD due'
    check('Anonymous unchanged link renders exact captured invoice details', response.status_code == 200 and card is not None and card.select_one('h2').get_text() == original['reference'] + ' · ' + original['title'] and card.select_one('.prose').get_text() == original['instructions'] and expected_amount in card.get_text(' ', strip=True) and 'Agreed milestone invoice' in card.get_text())
    check('Anonymous unchanged link GET preserves financial and binding rows', payment_link_rows() == before)
    cases = (
        ('changed title', 'studio_invoices', original, 'title', 'Private changed payment title', 'invoice changed'),
        ('changed reference', 'studio_invoices', original, 'reference', 'PRIVATE-LINK-REFERENCE', 'invoice changed'),
        ('changed instructions', 'studio_invoices', original, 'instructions', 'Private changed invoice instructions', 'invoice changed'),
        ('changed cost', 'studio_invoices', original, 'amount_cents', original['amount_cents'] + 123, 'invoice changed'),
        ('changed currency', 'studio_invoices', original, 'currency', 'EUR', 'unavailable'),
        ('moved invoice project', 'studio_invoices', original, 'job_id', other['id'], 'unavailable'),
        ('moved project client', 'studio_jobs', job, 'client_id', other['client_id'], 'unavailable'),
        ('inactive original client', 'studio_clients', client, 'active', 0, 'unavailable'),
        ('paid invoice status', 'studio_invoices', original, 'status', 'paid', 'paid'),
    )
    for label, table, row, column, changed, state in cases:
        # Fixed identifiers above only. The fixture fault does not rewrite any
        # immutable payment request; restore the exact original cell even on failure.
        original_rows = payment_link_rows()
        try:
            db('UPDATE ci_' + table + ' SET ' + column + '=? WHERE id=?', [changed, row['id']])
            forbidden = [original['title'], original['reference'], original['instructions'], expected_amount,
                         'Agreed milestone invoice', '$' + format((original['amount_cents'] + 123) / 100, '.2f')]
            if column in ('title', 'reference', 'instructions'):
                forbidden.append(changed)
            payment_link_read_only_terminal(link, state, forbidden, 'Anonymous link after ' + label)
        finally:
            db('UPDATE ci_' + table + ' SET ' + column + '=? WHERE id=?', [row[column], row['id']])
            check('Anonymous link restores exact fixture after ' + label, payment_link_rows() == original_rows)


def payment_link_browser_isolation(browser):
    # The original browser flow has just prepared its legitimate deposit request.
    request = db('SELECT * FROM ci_payment_requests WHERE invoice_id=? ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1', [INVOICE['id']])[0]
    client = requests.Session()
    submit(client, BASE + '/existing/portal/index.php', 'login',
           {'email': 'alice@example.invalid', 'password': 'Synthetic client passphrase 2026'})
    review = soup(client.get(BASE + '/existing/portal/index.php?job=1'))
    links = review.select('a[href*="page=pay"]')
    check('Anonymous browser uses the exact rendered current request link', len(links) == 1 and request['status'] == 'prepared')
    link = payment_link_local_url(links[0]['href'])
    before = payment_link_rows()
    context = browser.new_context(viewport={'width': 1440, 'height': 1000}, reduced_motion='reduce')
    local = urlparse(BASE)
    blocked = []
    def local_only(route):
        target = urlparse(route.request.url)
        if (target.scheme, target.netloc) == (local.scheme, local.netloc):
            route.continue_()
        else:
            blocked.append((target.scheme, target.netloc))
            route.abort()
    context.route('**/*', local_only)
    check('Anonymous payment browser starts without an authenticated session', not context.cookies())
    page = context.new_page()
    errors = []
    page.on('pageerror', lambda error: errors.append(str(error)))
    try:
        for state in ('Valid', 'Terminal'):
            original_rows = payment_link_rows()
            try:
                if state == 'Terminal':
                    db("UPDATE ci_payment_requests SET status='revoked' WHERE id=?", [request['id']])
                for viewport, width, height in (('Desktop', 1440, 1000), ('Mobile', 390, 844)):
                    page.set_viewport_size({'width': width, 'height': height})
                    response = page.goto(link, wait_until='networkidle')
                    card = page.locator('article.workspace-card')
                    expect(card).to_have_count(1)
                    expect(card).to_be_visible()
                    check('Anonymous payment link ' + state + ' ' + viewport + ' returns protected HTTP content', response is not None and response.status == 200 and 'no-store' in response.headers.get('cache-control', '') and response.headers.get('referrer-policy') == 'no-referrer')
                    if state == 'Valid':
                        expect(card.locator('h2')).to_have_text(INVOICE['reference'] + ' · ' + INVOICE['title'])
                        expect(card.locator('.prose')).to_have_text(INVOICE['instructions'])
                        check('Anonymous payment link Valid ' + viewport + ' shows exact due amount', '$' + format(request['amount_cents'] / 100, '.2f') + ' USD due' in card.inner_text())
                    else:
                        expect(card.locator('.workspace-status')).to_have_text('revoked')
                        check('Anonymous payment link Terminal ' + viewport + ' hides invoice details and due amount', card.locator('h2, .prose, strong').count() == 0 and '$' not in card.inner_text() and all(not value or value not in page.locator('body').inner_text() for value in (INVOICE['title'], INVOICE['reference'], INVOICE['instructions'], 'USD due', 'request expires')))
                    check('Anonymous payment link ' + state + ' ' + viewport + ' fits viewport', page.evaluate('document.documentElement.scrollWidth <= innerWidth + 1'))
                    page.screenshot(path=str(QA / ('Payment-Link-' + state + '-' + viewport + '.png')), full_page=True)
            finally:
                if state == 'Terminal':
                    db('UPDATE ci_payment_requests SET status=? WHERE id=?', [request['status'], request['id']])
                check('Anonymous payment browser ' + state + ' restores financial and binding rows', payment_link_rows() == original_rows)
        check('Anonymous payment browser has no uncaught errors and no external requests', not errors and not blocked)
    finally:
        context.close()
    check('Anonymous payment browser preserves all original financial rows', payment_link_rows() == before)

    dest=WEB/'payment-upgrade';shutil.copytree(ROOT/'test-runtime/released-1.4.0',dest)

## 2026-11-06 — exact-source RC test wrapper

The RC test-package workflow must package the single event checkout identified by the full `GITHUB_SHA`. It must not fetch, restore or commit files from historical feature branches, and generated-source refresh must produce no tracked or untracked drift. Pull-request and feature-branch runs may cancel superseded work; exact `main` runs must remain retained.

`tools/build.py --commit "$GITHUB_SHA" --stage-rc rc-upload` is the only supported RC staging path. The builder first requires a clean exact commit, validates the aggregate release manifest, all three package manifests, archive and member hashes, portable unique member paths, directory inventories, checksum inventory, source commit and dynamically derived semantic version, and only then extracts the already-validated COMPLETE-UPLOAD bytes. The test-only note uses that manifest version and one real trailing newline. The workflow artifact is temporary test evidence, not a release asset, publication, deployment or authorization for live operations.

Any change to package layout or RC staging must extend the negative build guards. Never weaken validation or import an overlay to make a candidate pass. Preserve failed and historical wrapper runs as source-bound evidence; only the exact reviewed successor and its resulting-main run may qualify the current wrapper.

# Master client portal — 1.26.1 development candidate

## Scope
The owner asked to continue integration and verify the previously requested master portal for administrator accounts. Before this increment, the portal login directed administrators back to Client support and did not have a unified master landing page.

This increment adds a portal hub at `portal/index.php?master=1`, plus a Master client portal link in the authenticated admin sidebar. A signed-in administrator visiting the bare client-portal URL is directed to the hub. An unsigned master request goes through the existing administrator sign-in with one fixed internal return destination; invitation, checkout, invoice, support and other customer deep links are not hijacked.

Owners can search and open any active client through the existing audited, time-limited support mechanism. Ordinary administrators require support.login permission and an explicit client support policy. The list enforces these limits in SQL before search and pagination. Customer-only accounts, matching emails, disabled users, expired/revoked sessions and active support contexts do not gain master access.

The hub links to existing permitted client, product, hosting, billing and 20i screens. It is not a combined cross-client financial report. It does not automatically manufacture a customer account for an administrator, merge identities by email, copy passwords, approve client contracts, sign finance agreements, charge cards or provision services. An administrator's personal purchases still require a real customer identity. The portal entry uses the existing administrator credentials rather than treating them as customer credentials.

## Source and tests
Five exact-before/after source hooks are applied by `tools/integration/master_portal_wiring.py` on the existing isolated integration branch. The ordinary expanded PHP source, receipt and regenerated installer inventory are then committed by the existing assembly job; main and production are untouched. No existing authentication, support, payment or sandbox guard is removed.

Local PHP syntax checks and 42 pure routing/search-policy assertions passed. Real SQL assertions and installed Chromium journeys are added for PHP8.4 with MariaDB/MySQL and must actually complete before their results are claimed. The tests exercise administrator sign-in return, client search/pagination, owner review, staff restrictions, CSRF refusal, customer/admin email collision, session revocation and desktop/mobile layout against synthetic data only.

The broader 1.26.1 release gates remain: exact-source integration and populated upgrade regression, expanded financial/payoff-state retention, Apache/rewrite and historical full-suite reconciliation, independent security review, reviewed main integration and verified standalone packages. Prior source successes are not evidence that this increment already passed. This is not a production deployment or an approved UPDATE ZIP.

class _ReleaseAssetRedirect(HTTPRedirectHandler):
    def redirect_request(self,request,file_pointer,code,message,headers,new_url):
        return None

def urlopen(url,timeout=60):
    """Prefer the published URL; use only its pinned release-asset API identity on transport failure."""
    failure=None
    try:
        return _urlopen(url,timeout=timeout)
    except HTTPError as error:
        if error.code < 500 or error.code > 599:
            raise
        failure=error
    except (URLError,TimeoutError) as error:
        failure=error
    asset_id=RELEASE_ASSET_IDS.get(url) if isinstance(url,str) else None
    if asset_id is None:
        raise failure
    headers={
        'Accept':'application/octet-stream',
        'X-GitHub-Api-Version':'2022-11-28',
        'User-Agent':'CajunWebPro-release-acceptance',
    }
    token=os.environ.get('GITHUB_TOKEN')
    if token:
        headers['Authorization']='Bearer '+token
    request=Request('https://api.github.com/repos/afterburn25/Cajun_Web/releases/assets/'+str(asset_id),headers=headers)
    try:
        return build_opener(_ReleaseAssetRedirect).open(request,timeout=timeout)
    except HTTPError as redirect:
        if redirect.code not in (301,302,303,307,308):
            raise
        location=redirect.headers.get('Location','')
        redirect.close()
        target=urlsplit(location)
        if target.scheme!='https' or target.hostname not in {'release-assets.githubusercontent.com','objects.githubusercontent.com'}:
            raise RuntimeError('Release asset API returned an untrusted redirect')
        return _urlopen(location,timeout=timeout)
